articles.text: LĚKÈLÁIĚR: Wèi, shi Wàijiāobù ma? Wǒ yào zhǎo Lín Sīzhǎng shuō huà.
LECLAIRE: Hello, is this the Ministry of Foreign Affairs? I'd like to speak with Department Chief Lín.
LĚKÈLÁIĚR: Wǒ shi Fǎguo Dàshǐguǎnde Jīngjìguān.
LECLAIRE: I'm the Economics Officer from the French Embassy.
MÌSHŪ: Nín děngyiděng, wǒ gěi nín kànkan tā zài bu zài.
SECRETARY: Wait a moment. I'll see whether he's here.
MÌSHŪ: Wèi, tā zhèihuǐr bú zài. Nín yào liú ge huàr ma?
SECRETARY: Hello. He's not here at the moment. Would you like to leave a message?
LĚKÈLÁIĚR: Láojià, tā huílaide shíhou, qǐng ta gěi wo dǎ ge diànhuà.
LECLAIRE: Please, when he comes back, ask him to give me a call.
MÌSHŪ: Hǎo, qǐng nín bǎ nínde diànhuà hàomǎr gàosong wo. Wǒ xiěxialai.
SECRETARY: All right, please tell me your phone number. I'll write it down.
